note: A proposal the Owner may change or switch off. Each id is one of the 21 premade voices his ElevenLabs connection already lists (read on a copy of data/studio.db, 2026-09-24); nothing was synthesised to choose them. A voice he binds to a character in the character bible always wins over this file. With use_until_the_owner_binds false, a character with no bound voice speaks in the narrator's voice. The narrator is not chosen here: it is the channel's own voice (on his data the Organization default, Roger, CwhRBWXzGAHq8TQ4Fs17), which no character below uses.

Sarah Executive.why: Authoritative and measured; a confident, professional woman's voice for the executive who asks for the number.

Dr. Aris Researcher.why: Unhurried and explanatory, middle-aged, British; the silver-templed researcher who defines a term before he uses it.

Elena Fact-Checker.why: Clear and precise; a checklist voice that numbers its points.

Marcus Scriptwriter.why: Fast and energetic; the writer who pitches out loud in fragments.

Lyra Voice Artist.why: Warm broadcast delivery; the studio's own voice artist should sound like one.

Kael Video Editor.why: Quick and energetic, distinct from Marcus by accent; the control-room editor who quotes durations to the second.

Vera Distribution Hub.why: Crisp and steady alto; status first, no adjectives.

Nadia Accountant.why: Even and professional; the amount, then the reference, then the period.
